brief: Give the diorama a foreground. Rows 79..87 of the grid - everything south of LN_WALK_S, the nine rows nearest the observer - are VOID, and drawGround skips VOID, so the bottom of every frame is unpainted canvas. buildGrid already says what belongs there: 'below the lane: our own building, with the river slipping between its two halves'. Build it, seen from ABOVE, as the sill implies: the roof of the block we are looking out over - pitches and ridges running along the lane, a leaded valley the rain runs down, chimneys, a dormer or skylight, moss on the north slope, the parapet and gutter at its lane edge. It is the largest-celled part of the picture and it should pick up the systems it already lives among: snowCover/snowAt whiten it, drawRoofRow's sun/cloud/warmth shading, wetF sheen, CHIMNEYS[]/drawSmoke(t) leaning windDir(), windowLit for anything glazed, MUR_ROOSTS or a landed bird on the ridge. This is the bet: a 150-300 line diff is expected and welcome. Take the swing.
measured: seed 42, t=350 (day 6, 14:43). Desktop 1600x950 -> canvas 1228x859: project(60,79,0)[1] = 676.4, project(60,88,0)[1] = 732.5, sillTop() = 794.6 - a black band of 118 px, 13.8% of the picture. Phone 390x844 -> canvas 374x757.25: 536.2 / 572.0 / 700.5 - 164 px, 21.7%. VOID cells: 1107 of 12144 (9.1% of the grid). Note there are two zones: rows 79..87, and a further 62 px BELOW row 88 that only the river's gradient poly currently fills (`project(QUAY_X0, WH, 0)` -> H, in drawGround). Both need to be something.
successLooksLike: The wide shot at 1x has no black band - on a 1600x950 desktop AND on a 390x844 phone, before and after crops of the bottom third. The census moves at least one structural scalar (`structures` 2916 and `passages` 1071 have not moved in 99 iterations; `developed`/`tileKinds` count too) - re-pin with `census.mjs --save-baseline` and say so in the entry, per the WATCH note. At night at least one thing up there is lit or smoking, and on a snowy day it is white.
avoid: Do NOT occlude the lane. If you raise a volume through buildVolumes, its drawn top must stay south of the lane's south footway - check against the 676.4 px line above. Do NOT move FOCUS, PINCH, WH, GW or any QUARTERS box: #99 has just settled the camera and `where-identity` is the gate for that. Keep x QUAY_X0..RIVER_X1 as WATER - the river slips between the block's two halves and its gradient already carries it off the bottom. Do not turn this into a walkable place with its own population; nobody needs to go up there this iteration.
